title: Ordinary v10 steel durable input boundary; old five child contracts stay unchanged

sequenceNo.description: Canonical positive PostgreSQL BIGINT decimal string, at most 9223372036854775807; never parse through Number.

applicabilitySnapshot.description: Domain hash over {hashDomain: matrix-kr056-steel-applicability-run-snapshot-json-v1, snapshot: entire object except contentHash}. Entries strictly sorted by pairKey; keys and decisionIds unique. Object and manifest equal outer, lease and every child. included entries form an exact decisionId/projectionContentHash bijection with steelComparison.applicabilityDecisions; excluded entries prohibit that projection.

inventory.description: Existing frozen child boundary, validated completely by validateInventoryLoaderPackage; unchanged from loader v5.

railInventory.description: Existing frozen child boundary, validated completely by validateRailInventoryLoaderPackage; unchanged from loader v5.

waterNode.description: Existing frozen child boundary, validated completely by validateWaterNodeLoaderPackage; unchanged from loader v5.

lightingTechnology.description: Existing frozen child boundary, validated completely by validateLightingTechnologyLoaderPackage; unchanged from loader v5.

reviewedLoader.description: Every child is fully validated by its frozen validator; all objects and input manifests equal outer and lease. Common source sourceId/SHA/stages/review-decision-ID/full-review-hash/classification projections agree across all six children; each scope keeps its own original provenance. Snapshot belongs to run state, excluded from the input manifest preimage to prevent a hash cycle.
